summary: Sandbach United are in full preparation mode for the upcoming 26/27 season, which kicks off in just one week! The squad has been bolstered with several exciting new signings and at least one returning player, while the club has also unveiled three brand new kits for the campaign ahead. In their recent friendly against St Helens, the Ramblers put on a solid display but fell short, with their opponents clinical in front of goal.
